FN-4L1W3I-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 229
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/17/2023
House Bill 229 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Unified
Judicial System and district attorneys to conduct reviews or hold hearings for petitions for
reduced sentences as provided in this bill.
This bill could also decrease the current or potential obligations of the Department of
Corrections by an undetermined amount dependent on (1) any reductions in sentences for
inmates provided by this bill, or (2) any sentences shorter than otherwise provided under current
enhanced sentencing law.

FN-4L1W3I-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 229
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 229 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the administrative
obligations of the Unified Judicial System and district attorneys to conduct reviews or hold
hearings for petitions for reduced sentences as provided in this bill.
This bill could also decrease obligations of the Department of Corrections by an undetermined
amount dependent on any reductions in sentences for inmates provided by this bill. The
provisions of this bill shall be repealed five years after the effective date.
